distribution.summary: 河南；陕西；江苏；江西；湖南；四川；福建；云南；重庆；广东；广西
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) reported 河南（信阳，桐柏），陕西（洵阳，石泉），江苏（南京），江西（庐山，弋阳），湖南（东安），四川（重庆，德昌），福建（南平，三明，永春），云南（思茅，西双版纳）. 黄复生等 (2015) reported 河南，陕西，江苏，江西，湖南，四川，福建，云南，重庆，广东，广西. These are literature-based reports; the mainland-China occurrence assessment remains Candidate pending checklist review.

host_note: Host names are retained as published, with separate source citations for 1984 and 2015; the latter may repeat earlier evidence rather than represent independent host confirmation. Host associations have not yet undergone independent review.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Orthotomicus erosus (Wollaston, 1857).
